newsitem.title: FRANCE: Club Med sees 400 mln Ffr profit in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Club Med sees 400 mln Ffr profit in 1997.

text.p: Club Mediterranee's objective of making a net profit of 400 million francs in 1997 is still achievable, chairman Serge Trigano said on Thursday.
"I continue to think that it is possible to attain this ambitious and delicate target, which is to realise 400 million francs of profit in 1997, he told a business conference
He added that the objective was attainable as long as the French economic situation did not deteriorate.

He declined to give a forecast for the second half of 1996, saying it was too early to take a view on current activity. However, he did reiterate the point made at the company's presentation of first-half result that the volume of worldwide sales was up five percent compared to a year ago, due mainly to growth in Club Aquarius.
Club Med posted first-half turnover of 3.8 billion francs versus 4.2 billion a year ago and net profit of 88 million compared to 75 million in the comparable period.
